title: Coming back from a tier's page keeps the list's filter and page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Pick Archived in the Status filter.
  3. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  4. Click Tiers in the breadcrumb.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens on Active.

Step 2:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 3:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 4:

  • The Tiers list shows with the Status filter still on Archived and tier A listed.
